errors.text_span: The chart is divided into eight categories
errors.evidence: The chart actually has ten categories: Social Media Post, External News Article, Organizational Website, Interview, Event Posting, Organizational Report, Draft/Other, Intra-agency News Article, Press Release, and one more. The description lists only 8 but Press Release (21.9%) is missing entirely.
Press Release (21.9%, gold/yellow color) is completely missing from the description despite being one of the largest segments in the chart.
The Intra-agency News Article slice appears to be orange/thin sliver, not pink. Pink/magenta is used for Organizational Report.
The Organizational Report slice appears to be a mauve/pink-purple color rather than magenta.
Event Posting appears to use a similar pink/mauve color as Organizational Report, not purple. The two share similar tones and are adjacent.
The chart does not include a separate legend box. Labels are placed directly outside the donut chart pointing to the segments with text annotations.

errors.text_span: Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice
errors.evidence: This is a donut chart, not a simple pie chart. The percentages are shown in the external text labels, not inside the slices themselves.

errors.text_span: the slices are ordered visually in descending size, from largest to smallest
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered in a clear descending sequence. For example, Press Release (21.9%) follows Intra-agency (0.7%) going clockwise, then External News Article (13.1%) follows, which is not a strict descending order.

errors.text_span: the label "Stimuli" prominently displayed toward the center
errors.evidence: The center of the donut chart displays "Stimuli Type" (two words), not just "Stimuli".
The description does not mention that this is a donut chart (ring/annular shape) rather than a solid pie chart.
